findings.issue: History & recovery requires a successful autosave before loading history. Open a project, make an unsaved scene edit, then corrupt its head: clicking recovery only sends project.save, reports a JSON error and never opens the panel. A stale revision conflict causes the same block. Reloading to reach recovery discards the retained local edit.
findings.fix: Make opening history read-only and independent of successful save; retain dirty editor state on save failure. Provide an explicit save/discard or local-copy choice before a restore replaces dirty work, including a reachable choice when the current head cannot be saved.
findings.evidence: frontend-repro.json: actual isolated Edge run; panelCount 0, requests [darzain.project.save], unsavedEditsRetained true

findings.issue: The history heading does not identify its target project or mark the current revision. Opening project B's history while project A remains in the editor leaves A's heading visible beneath the panel; projects with the same default name or damaged heads are difficult to distinguish before restoring.
findings.fix: Show the history target name plus a short stable project identifier and label its current revision; keep identity visible for damaged projects using the returned projectId.
